name: Foul Matriarch

meta.next: The Next Step (Skyborne), The Adventurer (Zephras Isle)

summary: In the caves south of Thendal Village, Aetheen of the Gales tests new initiates against the ursera. They must thin the packs and slay their den mother, Urs'anah, to prove they can face greater perils across Zephras Isle.

sections.title: A Test of Resolve
sections.body: Around Thendal Village, Aetheen of the Gales watches newcomers find their footing. When an initiate shows early skill, Aetheen sends them into the southern caves for a dangerous rite of passage. There, they thin the local ursera packs and face the broodmother who threatens the village's edge.

sections.title: The Threat of Urs'anah
sections.body: Local rangers know the ursera are fierce, but Urs'anah is the greatest threat to the haven. Deep in Thendal Cave, the formidable matriarch directs her scavengers and guards her lair. Her severed head proves an adventurer can face ferocious beasts and is ready to venture beyond the starting grove.

faq.q: Who assigns the task to kill Urs'anah?
aliases: who is aetheen of the gales
faq.answer: Aetheen of the Gales assigns the trial from Thendal Village. Aetheen watches promising newcomers noticed by local figures like Rorian, then tests their mettle with a dangerous hunt.

faq.q: Where can Urs'anah and the ursera scavengers be found?
faq.answer: Urs'anah and the ursera scavengers dwell in caves south and southwest of Thendal Village, in the hills within Thendal Grove. The matriarch's den lies deep in the cavern.
Ursera are aggressive, bear-like predators native to the wilder crags of Zephras Isle. Their scavenging packs can make dens dangerously close to settlements like Thendal Village.

faq.q: What does completing this hunt signify for an adventurer?
faq.answer: Slaying Urs'anah marks a rite of passage. By overcoming cultist interlopers and the grove's most dangerous wildlife, the hunter proves they are ready to leave Thendal Village's sanctuary and take on wider responsibilities across Zephras Isle.

angles.text: As a Skyborne initiate, mastering ground predators like Urs'anah shows you can fend for yourself on land. You are ready to venture beyond your secluded beginnings.
As a Hunter, tracking a fierce matriarch in her cave tests your knowledge of beasts and your resolve.
